why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 88's crop is bounded by '41ST ST' at the top (native y~2510) and '42ND ST' at the bottom; the block between them (S.E. 83, N.E. 108, S.E. 108, containing Woolam's Lake) carries the 4100-block avenue numbers 4103,4105,...,4127 and 4104,4106,...,4128. Sheet 98's top margin is that same 42nd St corridor: the blocks immediately south of it (N.W. 158, S.W. 158, N.W. 183) carry the 4200-block numbers 4201,4203,...,4227 and 4202,4204,...,4228, and one block further south sheet 98 prints '43RD ST' with the 4301,4303,4305 run beginning. So the 4100/4200 change is on the corridor taken, and 41st and 43rd are excluded. CAVEAT recorded, not reconciled: the two sheets draw different segments of 42nd St and do not overlap laterally - sheet 88's cross runs are the 2000/2100/2200 blocks (2013-2023, 2101-2111, 2113-2129, 2201-2213, avenues P1/2-R) while sheet 98's are the 2500/2600/2700 blocks (2509-2523, 2601-2611, 2613-2623, 2701-2711, avenues S-T1/2). The corridor identity is certain, but this is a collinearity constraint on one straight street, not a shared-detail tie. Plate scales also differ: block pitch 1160 native px on sheet 88 vs 1114 on sheet 98. Detection's candidates (2977 / 1002) are block-interior lines; centres read off the green native rulers.
